meta.name: Retro Spectrum Bars
meta.description: Authentic 1990s hi-fi hardware spectrum analyzers: switch between seven physically distinct vintage decks (Sony MHC-RX90 VFD, Aiwa HS-PX1000 Titanium LCD, Pioneer Carrozzeria cockpit VFD, Technics SH-GE70 amber VFD, Aiwa NSX / JVC MX VFD, Kenwood GE-7030 fine VFD, and Sansui Rack LED) with four classic display patterns, musical dB ballistics, and hardware peak hold.
meta.author: ViewMusic built-in
